title: ISCO Collection - AOC Project
author: Hayley Templar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.prrdm56

steps.title: Install and Configure ISCO Sampler
steps.instruction: Set up the Teledyne ISCO 3700 portable sequential sampler within a sturdy, locked enclosure.

substeps.instruction: Extend the 1/4-inch suction line from the sampler into the water body.
Secure the sample line using PVC pipe attached to a permanent structure (e.g., river wall or concrete river bed).
Install a Campbell Scientific CR1000 datalogger and AirLink LS300 Raven cell modem for remote control and monitoring.

steps.title: Program and Initialize Sampler
steps.instruction: Configure the sampler for the desired collection interval and activate it remotely.

substeps.instruction: Program the sampler to collect 250 mL every 15 minutes for up to 24 hours (creating one-hour composite samples per bottle).
Turn on the sampler remotely using the Campbell Scientific LoggerLink mobile application.

steps.title: Maintain Sample Preservation
steps.instruction: Ensure samples remain chilled during the collection period.

substeps.instruction: Replace ice once per day while the sampler is running.
If ice has melted during sample collection, record the temperature of the melted ice water on a field sheet.

steps.title: Prepare Collection Bottles
steps.instruction: Sanitize and rinse two-liter plastic Nalgene bottles before use.

substeps.instruction: Sanitize bottles with dish soap after each use.
Rinse bottles by pouring a small quantity of sample water into the Nalgene bottle, capping, shaking, and dumping; repeat this process 3 times to remove soap residue.

steps.title: Collect and Composite Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer samples from ISCO bottles to Nalgene bottles based on the timing relative to the event.

substeps.instruction: During and within 24 hours of an event: Combine two ISCO sample bottles into one two-liter Nalgene bottle (two-hour composite).
More than 24 hours after an event: Combine four ISCO sample bottles into one two-liter Nalgene bottle (four-hour composite).
Immediately place Nalgene bottles on ice and transport to the lab for filtering.

steps.title: Post-Collection Maintenance and Blanks
steps.instruction: Clean the sampler components and collect quality control blanks.

substeps.instruction: Rinse one-liter ISCO sample bottles 3 times with deionized water and replace them in the sampler after each sample is removed.
Collect bottle blanks once per event at each site by collecting a sample of deionized water using the standard field sample collection procedure.
